candidates.sourceTitle: Survei Status Gizi Indonesia (SSGI) 2024 Dalam Angka — current BKPK-linked release
candidates.unit: percent of measured children aged 0–59 months
candidates.denominator: Survey-weighted children age0–59 months with eligible height/age measurements; not all residents or a fixed administrative child registry.
candidates.definition: Height-for-age below-2 WHO z-scores, including severe stunting, among children0–59 months.
candidates.methodologyNotes: Current table4.14 has all27 regions and total stunting. Earlier launch table4.54 had22 regions and separate subclasses. Current methods permitSAE whereRSE>25%, response<70%, no secure fieldwork, or change>10% versus2023; table does not identify each district method. Fieldwork crosses into2025 but source reference remains2024.
candidates.comparabilityNotes: Age group and total-stunting construct match SKI2023; change fromSKI toSSGI, mixed direct/SAE estimation and cross-year fieldwork require explicit review. Not a proven year-on-year change or direct-only panel.
candidates.recommendation: Retain for human review before designing a new common-year model; do not replace the frozen 2023 input.
caveats: Direct versusSAE assignment is not labelled for each district; do not infer it from the five launch omissions.
Collection ranOctober2024–February2025; source calls the reference year2024.
Use published CIs; no CI/rank significance is reconstructed.

candidates.sourceTitle: Survei Status Gizi Indonesia (SSGI) 2024 Dalam Angka — current BKPK-linked release
candidates.unit: percent of measured children aged 0–59 months
candidates.denominator: Survey-weighted children age0–59 months with eligible weight-for-length/height measurements.
candidates.definition: Published Wasting column is moderate-only: -3 ≤ weight-for-length/height z-score < -2. Severe wasting below-3 is a separate column.
candidates.methodologyNotes: PDF41 defines moderate and severe categories separately; table4.14/PDF50 has27 moderate-wasting values. Frozen SKI2023 wasting is total below-2, including severe. Direct/SAE and fieldwork caveats also apply.
candidates.comparabilityNotes: Copying the published Wasting column would drop severe wasting and change the frozen construct. This audit does not silently sum rounded categories or manufacture a total-prevalence CI. A source-confirmed total or explicitly reviewed component-based bridge is still needed.
candidates.recommendation: Obtain the official below-2 total, or review an explicit severe+moderate bridge with source precision and uncertainty limits. Do not replace total SKI2023 wasting with moderate-only SSGI2024.
caveats: Numeric coverage27/27 is not construct compatibility.
Separate severe percentages and CIs exist in table4.14; confidence limits cannot be added to obtain a total CI.
